CustomField.description: A unique, code-friendly identifier for this template. A slash command names a template by it (AIChatCommand__mdt.PromptTemplateDeveloperName__c), and the model uses it to pick a template when no command was used.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use a short, unique identifier of lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (e.g. draft_client_email). Needed for a slash command to select this template, and for the model to choose it on its own.
CustomField.label: Developer Name
